Abstract Art

抽象艺术 · 163 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Abstract art used to be controversial. On the one hand, the artists stopped painting delicate figures and adopted special techniques to create different visual effects. On the other hand, their works, including sculptures carved from marble or made of fragile clay, had the specific aim of expressing feelings. Some conventional scholars who were allergic to abstract art said it was evidently ridiculous and neither art nor geometry. Their Traditional Art Committee predicted that it would soon disappear.

2But nowadays, abstract art has become a permanent part of contemporary civilisation. Galleries along Madison Avenue put on many superb exhibitions of abstract works, appealing to many who have a preference for abstract art. The Shadow of Egypt, a café in this district, has become a meeting place for those bold abstract artists. Consequently, it is hardly surprising to meet one of these renowned artists there in the flesh. Their loyal fans ask for their signatures, give them bunches of fragrant flowers and praise their work.

抽象艺术

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1抽象艺术曾引发争议。一方面，画家不再描绘细腻的人物形象，转而用特别的手法给观众带来不同的视觉感受。另一方面，包括大理石雕塑和易碎的黏土作品在内，他们的创作都有明确的目的，就是表达感受。一些排斥抽象艺术的传统学者说，它显然荒唐，既称不上艺术，也算不上几何。他们所在的传统艺术委员会预言，这门艺术很快就会消失。

2如今，抽象艺术已经成了当代文明中长久存在的一部分。麦迪逊大道沿线的画廊举办过许多精彩的抽象艺术展，吸引了一大批喜爱这门艺术的人。这一带有家叫“埃及之影”的咖啡馆，成了那些大胆的抽象艺术家的聚会场所。因此，在那里亲眼见到一位声名在外的艺术家，并不稀奇。忠实的仰慕者常找他们签名，送上香气扑鼻的鲜花，也送上许多赞美。
